newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian woman kills daughters, commits suicide.
newsitem.headline: Colombian woman kills daughters, commits suicide.

text.p: A mother in southwest Colombia poisoned her three daughters and then committed suicide because of money worries, police said on Thursday.

The bodies of the 27-year-old woman and her children, the youngest of whom was 20 months old, were discovered on Thursday in a house in the town of San Agustin, in a mountain region of Huila province.
Police said the woman died from drinking poisoned water and apparently had financial problems.
